impact.text: Any attacker can drain any user's vault balance by simply calling these functions with the victim as owner and attacker as receiver.

precondition_sources.text: Victim deposits 100 assets into the vault and receives 100 shares.
Victim sets a self-allowance of 100 via permit(victim, victim, 100), required for normal protocol usage.

intent_sources.text: The withdraw and redeem functions must verify that msg.sender has permission to act on behalf of owner (is the owner or has an allowance from the owner) before burning the owner's shares.
The self-allowance check must not be treated as authorization for a caller other than the owner to burn the owner's shares.
